content.text:
The cheapest one is Clal (כלל): 0.48% a year. Pretty sure. It was easy because the page already had קרן השתלמות and "עוקב מדד S&P 500" switched on. The line above the table says "דמי ניהול מהחיסכון: מ־0.48% עד 0.7%", and Clal is the one with 0.48%. Menora Mivtachim (מנורה מבטחים) is close at 0.49%, and Harel (הראל) and Migdal (מגדל) are at 0.5%. Clal is a name I know, so that helps too.

**Where I looked, in order:**
- **Top of the page:** The heading "כל המסלולים בכל החברות". The "קרן השתלמות 154" and "עוקב מדד S&P 500 12" buttons were already lit. Then the line "12 מסלולים של 12 חברות" and the 0.48% to 0.7% range.
- **The note under that:** "מהיקר לזול", meaning the list goes from most expensive to cheapest. So I knew the cheap ones were at the bottom.
- **The table:** I scrolled down it and only looked at the "דמי ניהול" column. Mor (מור) 0.7% at the top, then Altshuler Shaham (אלטשולר שחם) 0.66%, Analyst (אנליסט) 0.62% and so on, down to Clal 0.48%.
- **The last row:** Ayalon (איילון קופות גמל) has no number, just "עוד לא דווח" and a little warning mark. It also has only about 40% in shares. I skipped it.

**What I skipped:** The returns and "חשיפה" columns, the circle charts, the grey text at the bottom, the "PF-06" box and the menu tabs at the top.

**What I didn't get:**
- "אין ההפקדות", written under every fee. I guess it means there's no fee on the monthly deposits, but I'm not sure.
- "מט"ח" next to the percentages.
- The column "תשואה... לפני דמי ניהול". Is the return before or after fees?
- "קופה" with the numbers like 13342. I have no idea what those are.

**What bothered me:**
- The table starts with the most expensive one, so you have to scroll to the very end for the cheapest. I almost thought Mor was the cheapest because it's first.
- The differences are tiny, 0.48% against 0.5%. In percent it all looks like nothing. I'd have wanted to see it in shekels.
- I didn't find a "join" button or a first step anywhere. So I know which one to pick, but not how to move my keren to it.
